narr: A slow moving thunderstorm in Beaumont produced isolated flooding.
ev: Washington Blvd near MLK in Downtown Beaumont became impassable. The Crocket Street underpass was also filled to the top.
lsr: Waashington Blvd toward MLK in downtown Beaumont reported flooded and impassable.
6 inches of water covering parts of Franklin Street near downtown Beaumont.
Underpass on South 4th near Crockett Street filled to near the top.
